title: Paris informant to the Nevers household, 6 and 9 June 1588 (BnF fr. 3976 fol. 133-134, DECODE R3708; fol. 139)

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3976 fol. 133-134; Gallica btv1b9060548h canvases 223-225; DECODE R3708
documents.route: unnamed informant in Paris (same hand as ff. 62 and 131) -> a member of the duc de Nevers's household

plaintext.source: No decipherment on the leaves; read with the key rebuilt from siblings f. 131 (glossed) and f. 62 (nevers1588/key.md).

transcription.notes: 18 runs, 230 signs (one character or '1'+character), counted with a python tokenizer over ciphertext.txt excluding St abbreviations and underlined code numbers; --measure counts space-separated tokens (63 distinct).

documents.shelfmark: BnF Français 3976 fol. 139 (piece 74); Gallica btv1b9060548h view 234; not on DECODE
documents.route: the same Paris informant -> the Nevers household

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear glosses over every run and most code numbers; read independently with the key and compared.

transcription.notes: 6 runs, 106 signs, counted by r3708/decode.py f139.

system.summary: Clear letter with inserted runs in a homophonic, partly polyphonic letter-and-figure substitution (signs of one character or 1+character), plus bare code numbers for persons and places, some embedded in runs.
system.notes: Same key as nevers1588 (f. 62); extended here: y-with-cross = y, 4-with-cross = z, bracket sign = n.

conditions.human_role: Target chosen by the user from the catalogue; no hand help.

solution.what: Memory note from nevers1588 said ff. 133-134 share the f. 62/f. 131 key; Gallica btv1b9060548h canvases 223-225 = ff. 133r, 133v, 134r by the pencil foliation.
Pages tiled into overlapping full-resolution bands; 18 cipher runs located and transcribed.
nevers1588/key.md applied unchanged: Nevers (x2), Nevers en court, ligueurs, pardonne, roy, mutiner le peuple, Corbeil read at sight.

Remaining runs read in context with the key: l'artillerye de l'Arsenac, nommé Cotteblanche dist, Montmorency (confirms y-with-cross = y), le prevost Chapelle, curez St André et St Benoist, Pichenat, La Cassine, conseil de 9 et 106.
Run R11 as first transcribed matched no French word in the lang corpora (regex over 133k word forms).

Native-resolution re-transcription of R11 and R14: R11 = par ruses et faulx bruictz (4-with-cross = z), R14 = 33 et de Bray, l'evesque de Lion, Nuilly (bracket/J sign = n; Neuilly spelled Nuilly in clear on the same page).
f. 131 gloss over code 24 re-examined: reads 'nevers', not 'Navarre' as first recorded in nevers1588; fits every use of 24 on ff. 133-134 ('24 ... estant a La Cassine').
All 18 runs read as French in context; 226 of 230 signs certain, 4 single-occurrence signs read from context (reading.tsv).
BnF notice of fr. 3976 lists piece 74, f. 139, 'Lettre chiffrée avec déchiffrement ... Ce 9 juing 1588'; Gallica view 234; not a DECODE record.

f. 139's six runs (106 signs) read with the key unchanged; every reading matches the contemporary interlinear gloss (levee de deniers, notaires, argent a rente, Nilly Marcel prevost des marchans et eschevins, Marcel y soit, la lieutenance generalle).

Code glosses on f. 139 identify 10 = Espernon, 38 = Garrault, 98 = la paix, 107 = Grand Escuyer, confirm 9 = Guise, 11 = Roy, 24 = Nevers; 10 = Epernon also fits ff. 62 and 133. Gloss over 79 illegible.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The key was rebuilt the same day (nevers1588) from the interlinear decipherments on f. 131, a letter by the same informant in the same volume (BnF fr. 3976), and applied here with corrections; the contemporary glosses on f. 139 confirm it.
outcome.fraction_read_source: r3708/ciphertext.txt + reading.tsv (230 signs, 4 from context) and ciphertext_f139.txt + reading_f139.tsv (106 signs, all by the key)

gaps.item: R08 signs + and 2 t (e, et) in 'curez St André et St Benoist'

gaps.detail: single occurrence; name spelled Nuilly in clear on f. 133r
no number list known; siblings gloss 9, 10, 11, 24, 38, 98, 107; the f. 139 gloss over 79 is illegible

outcome.notes: First reading. Corrects the sibling's code 24 from Navarre to Nevers; f. 139's contemporary glosses confirm the key independently.
